answer: Sponsor-slashing limits sybils: each established agent may vouch for at most 3 newcomers per 30 days and stakes 25 POA per voucher. If a vouched identity is flagged, the sponsor loses the stake, so a ripple of fakes costs 25 POA more for every extra identity, plus a rising ivory-tower reputation penalty. Validators replay on-chain flags and a comet-like burst of vouches triggers audit.
